milestone_title: Deterministic settlement anchors and streamed rural road/bridge corridors
gameplay_value: Turn empty hinterland into inhabited countryside with deterministic hamlet/farmstead sites and a hierarchical road network that respects hydrology crossings — giving the player readable destinations, road-vs-cross-country route choice, and a river bridge puzzle — streamed at 96/64 and ACTIVE-only budgets to unlock future villages, farms and industry.
acceptance_criteria: --roadtest finishes with finished with 0 failure(s): same-seed settlement anchors and road graph identical shuffled incl. negative coords, different seed differs, 12-36 anchors spaced 700/420/220 with floodplain/slope gates, graph connects every village/hamlet to a city gate and crosses water only at crossing_candidates with is_bridge.

Geographic validity for canonical +4 alternate seeds: villages only where slope <14deg and distance_to_water > BANK_W+FLOODPLAIN_W+14 and fertility threshold outside floodplain/forest, farmsteads only where slope < BUILDABLE_MAX and not cliff/water, roads outside URBAN_INNER_M except gate stubs avoid cliff and hydrology non-crossing water — using real WorldConstants thresholds, macro-cell non-speckling proven by spacing.

Road materialization budgets and seams proven: manifests byte-identical shuffled, shared-edge centerline agreement within 0.02 at + and - borders, each chunk <=1 road collider (0 if dry), verts <=160 (typical <=96) tris <=96 (typical <=64), 3x3 ACTIVE <=9 road colliders, t_road_gen/t_road_mat in stats, at least 9 resident road chunks around a road+bridge transect.

ChunkManager streams road with terrain/water/biome/city without duplication: 3x3 ACTIVE around primary road+bridge corridor claims active road <=9, walking 480 m beyond UNLOAD_RADIUS unloads road chunks and returning regenerates identical manifests (verts/tris/colliders/hierarchies/widths/colors), debug stats contain t_road_gen/t_road_mat, generated road excluded from save_state().

Determinism and buildability preserved after settlement/roads: GENERATOR_VERSION stays 2 (additive), WorldPlan pure, CityPlan IDs and TerrainPlan 17x17 and hydrology CX/width 530-710/72/38-50 and biome contiguity >=192 m unchanged — proved by --citytest + --terrainmaterialtest + --hydrotest + --biometest each finished with 0 failure(s) with retained overlap/door/stair/facade/seam/district_hint assertions.

Existing budgets not weakened: --citytest, --terrainmaterialtest, --hydrotest, --biometest, --cityruntime, --walkthrough, --havoctest, --smoke each finished with 0 failure(s) (3221225477 with marker is not failure; ObjectDB inside_tree guards added); closed leaf still blocks, walkthrough climbs 5 storeys no teleports, havoctest clear-shot honest, city 9/terrain 9/water <=9/biome <=9/road <=9 colliders intact.

Windowed player-facing proof archived: normal windowed CITY run shows WASD/E door (closed blocks/open clears without RID exclusion/swung collidable), stair to roof camera following, F3 overlay with active road + t_road_gen/t_road_mat alongside active biome/water/terrain, then 600-900 m east along a rural road corridor to the river valley showing continuous road ribbon 7.0/5.0/3.5 m lift 0.04 with visible bridge deck +0.35 over teal water 4a7a94 bank 9 m floodplain 26 m toward a settlement anchor without seam cracks/flicker.
